frozen_by: Lead C (scientific evaluation lead), Prophet x Sector Intelligence programme

data_pin.prices: data/yahoo/<TICKER>.parquet column 'close' (dividend/split adjusted total-return close); column 'close_price' (raw) only for comparing to published raw plan levels
data_pin.sector_labels: data/breadth/sp1500_pit_sectors.parquet (current-basis GICS, era_correct=false) then plan board_read.fields.sector.value
data_pin.unused_noted: macro#10965 claude/si-lane1-pit-fields-20261110 @ a089d2f9b4 (US theme-basket PIT store, snapshots from 2026-08-13; NOT used; theme baskets are outside this protocol)

window.stability_halves: split at the 32nd daily return; descriptive only
window.reason_start: incumbent selection era anticipation-v1-2026-08-08; earliest era recorded_at 2026-08-09; first possible fill 2026-08-10 close

execution.signal_clock: close of decision session t, using data with date <= t only
execution.rule_execution: close of session t+1 (one-session lag); returns accrue from t+1 close
execution.drift: buy-and-hold drift between rebalances; C6/C7/C6A re-equalised daily
execution.fill_model: close-only; no intraday prices; no fill at a price not printed as a close
execution.no_fill: a position whose fill session has no valid close is a no-fill (counted, not held)
execution.cash: uninvested weight earns BIL total return

comparators.C2_simple_participation: 100% SPY if SPY adjusted close(t) > its 200-session simple moving average(t) else 100% BIL; evaluated daily; executed t+1
comparators.C3_sector_allocation_only: equal weight (1/3) in the top 3 of XLB XLC XLE XLF XLI XLK XLP XLRE XLU XLV XLY by RS63 = 63-session total return minus SPY 63-session total return; rebalance every 21 sessions
comparators.C4_member_selection_only: S&P 1500 PIT members at t (start_date<=t<end_date or open), sector label present, >=126 valid closes, raw close>=5; score = 63-session total return minus own sector SPDR 63-session total return; per sector take top k=max(3,ceil(0.10*n_s)) equal weight; sector weights fixed = non-negative least squares style weights of SPY daily returns on the 11 SPDRs over the 252 sessions ending 2026-08-07, normalised to 1; rebalance every 21 sessions
comparators.C5_joint_sector_and_name: C3's top-3 sectors (1/3 each); within each, C4's top-k members by C4 score, equal weight; rebalance every 21 sessions
comparators.C6_exact_incumbent_prophet: index.json plans with selection_era == anticipation-v1-2026-08-08; publication session P = first session s with s > price_basis_date and s >= recorded_at; entered iff entry_zone_state.state in {filled, converted} and ledger outcome != NO_ENTRY; entry session E = first session >= max(P, filled_date if present); exit X = ledger close_date (last session <= close_date) when the plan is in the ledger, else first session after E with raw close <= invalidation or raw close >= targets[0] or date >= price_basis_date + horizon_days calendar days, else censored at window end; if X <= E the position is excluded (resolved_at_or_before_follower_fill); book = equal weight across open positions, re-equalised daily, 100% BIL when none
comparators.C7_independent_emergence: C6 restricted to plans whose sector SPDR is NOT in C3-rule top-3 computed at the close of price_basis_date
comparators.C6A_context_aligned_prophet: C6 restricted to plans whose sector SPDR IS in that top-3 (diagnostic counterpart to C7)
comparators.X6_exposure_matched_reference: daily weight w(t-1) in SPY and 1-w(t-1) in BIL where w is C6's risky weight at the previous close

metrics: beta_vs_market (OLS of daily strategy minus BIL on SPY minus BIL)
intercept_ann (252 x OLS intercept; NOT labelled alpha)
upside_capture (geometric mean daily return on SPY-up days / SPY's)
hit_rate_vs_spy (positions; holding-window total return beats SPY over same window; Wilson 95% CI)

attribution_bridge (C6/C7/C6A only; daily arithmetic accounting identity: market = sum w_i x r_SPY, sector = sum w_i x (r_ETF(i) - r_SPY), selection = sum w_i x (r_i - r_ETF(i)), cash = w_cash x r_BIL, costs; legs sum to the arithmetic sum of daily net returns; compounding residual reported separately)

event_study (all C6-era published plans, policy-free, engine.grading.forward_metrics next-bar fill from the session before P; H = 10, 21, 42, 63 sessions; excess vs SPY, sector ETF minus SPY, stock minus sector ETF; matured horizons only)

statistics.bootstrap: stationary bootstrap (Politis-Romano) of the daily series, mean block length 10 sessions, B = 10000, seed 20261110; paired (strategy, reference, SPY, BIL) rows resampled together
statistics.p_value: one-sided, H0: mean daily net differential <= 0; p = share of centred bootstrap means >= observed mean
statistics.event_study_ci: cluster bootstrap over publication dates, B = 10000, same seed
statistics.secondary_family_holm_alpha_0.05: C6 restricted to each admission_class stratum (patience, confirmation, early_turn_starter) minus C1; the eight catalog sleeves carry no plan link and are NOT evaluable
statistics.capture_ratio_guard: capture unavailable when |SPY geometric mean on the relevant days x days| < 0.01

acceptance.L0_descriptive: source-correct: >= 90% of era plans classified (evaluated or excluded with a closed reason) and >= 95% of entered positions priced; numbers shown as descriptive with CIs, no performance claim

L1_accepted_historical.job_A_market_participation_C6: all of: beta point in [0.8,1.3] and CI lower >= 0.6; upside_capture point >= 0.90 and CI lower >= 0.75; mean_invested >= 0.80; ann_excess_vs_spy CI lower > -0.03 (non-inferiority margin -3.0 pp/yr); non-inferiority point holds at 2x costs
L1_accepted_historical.job_B_sector_context_K3_K5_K7: Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05; point ann differential >= +0.02; holds at 2x costs; K3 additionally C3 - exposure-matched SPY/BIL CI lower > 0
L1_accepted_historical.job_C_member_selection_K2_K4_K6: Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05; point ann differential >= +0.02; holds at 2x costs

acceptance.L2_prospective_shadow: L1 met, then >= 126 sessions after 2026-11-11 evaluated under this unchanged header hash and code with the same job criteria holding
acceptance.L3_approved_product_prediction: L2 plus independent non-author review and acceptance through the existing Evaluation owner; never assignable by this harness
acceptance.below_global_minimum: release level for every performance job is capped at L0_descriptive regardless of point estimates

biases.membership_survivorship: C4/C5 use S&P 1500 PIT start/end dates; the PIT file's last recorded change is 2026-06-02 so later index changes are unrecorded (counted); PIT members without a price file are excluded and counted; theme-basket rosters (current, back-dated added) are not used
biases.sector_labels_current_basis: GICS labels are current, not era-correct; disagreements between the two label sources are counted
biases.plan_selection_backfill: publication clock recorded_at governs entry; legacy-era plans excluded from C6; entry_date before recorded_at shifted to P; resolved-before-fill excluded and counted; sensitivity excluding plans with a plan_corrections.jsonl row
biases.short_sample: 64 sessions, one regime; capped at L0 by the global minimum
biases.overlapping_horizons: portfolio series use block bootstrap; event-study uses date-cluster bootstrap
biases.lookahead: all rule signals use closes <= t and execute at t+1; tests assert truncation invariance
biases.close_only_fills: no intraday data; zone fills at the filled_date close, never at the zone price
biases.snapshot_not_vintage: index.json is the 2026-11-09 snapshot of plans, not each plan's as-published bytes

contamination_disclosure: Before freezing, Lead C saw: ledger field names and the outcome label vocabulary (EXPIRED, INVALIDATED, NO_ENTRY, T1_HIT, T2_HIT) without category counts or any stock_result_pct value; index lifecycle_counts (resolved 529, entered 275, ready 64, invalidated 25); outcome labels and days_held of 6 printed ledger rows; one plan (GPCR-BULL-20260604) shown closed/stopped out with last_price 20.35 vs entry 53.14; SPY adjusted close levels on 1993-01-29, 1993-02-01, 2026-11-06 (735.29) and 2026-11-09 (752.69), no window return; the brief's statement that lane 8's sector-rotation comparator did not beat passive SPY after costs on its own window. No strategy, comparator or plan-population return over the window was computed or seen. Lead C's model knowledge ends June 2026 and contains no August-November 2026 market path. C3/C4/C5 rule parameters (RS63, top-3, 21-session rebalance, top-10% per sector) are conventional defaults chosen without tuning.
deviation_rule: any departure from this header is logged in RESULTS_v1.md and in the artifact's deviations[] with reason; thresholds never change after outcome access
